Attendance Tracker

Track class attendance: roster with present/absent marks per date and % summaries.

Roster —

Attendance summary

📖 How to use

  1. Add student names to the roster.
  2. Pick a date.
  3. Click Present or Absent for each student — saved automatically.
  4. View per-student attendance % in the summary.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I take attendance?

Add student names to the roster, pick a date, then click Present or Absent next to each name. Marks are saved per date.

How do I record a different day?

Change the date picker and mark again — each date has its own record.

What does the summary show?

The summary shows per-student: present days, total days, and attendance %.

Where is the data stored?

In this browser's localStorage — private to this device.
